title: Word42 — a classic word processor
excerpt: Word42 is a classic word processor, written from scratch in C on GTK 4, Pango and Cairo: inspired by classic Microsoft Word and by AbiWord, on a modern text stack. Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.
content_html:
Written from scratch in C on GTK 4, Pango and Cairo: a menu bar, two toolbars, a ruler, a status bar and a page. Inspired by classic Microsoft Word and AbiWord, on a modern text stack that handles Unicode, OpenType and complex scripts properly.

Download View on GitHub

Word42 in Page Layout view.

Features

A working word processor, not a demo — everything below ships today.

Writing and editing

  • Typing, selection and undo the way you expect
  • Find and replace
  • A split window on one document
  • Autosave every two minutes, with recovery

Formatting

  • Fonts, colour, bold, italic, underline, super- and subscript
  • Styles and numbered headings — 1, 1.1, 1.2
  • Bulleted and numbered lists
  • Newspaper columns, balanced on the last page

Page layout

  • Headers, footers and page numbers
  • Footnotes and endnotes
  • Tables with merged cells, pictures
  • Page-layout view and print preview

Tools

  • Spelling and hyphenation
  • Mail merge, envelopes and labels
  • Table of contents and an index
  • Templates, AutoText and AutoFormat

File formats

  • RTF and OpenDocument .odt
  • Word .docx and .doc
  • AbiWord .abw
  • HTML, PDF and plain text

Modern text, fast

  • Unicode, OpenType and complex scripts via Pango
  • Long documents stay quick — a keystroke lays out only what it changed
  • Pages break in the same place at every zoom, on every screen
  • The user guide travels inside the program — press F1

The user guide describes every command in the program; the status page and architecture notes tell the rest.

Get Word42

macOS

An unsigned Word42.app from the releases page. First launch is a right-click ▸ Open.
